hero.title: MBS in Sweden for Indian Students
paras: **Business Studies in Sweden** offers international students opportunities to develop knowledge in business administration, economics, management, marketing and international trade. Students can begin with an undergraduate business degree after Class 12 and progress to a specialised master's programme after completing their bachelor's qualification.

highlights.title: World-Class Nordic Innovation

highlights.title: English-Taught Degrees
highlights.desc: Over 1,000 bachelor's and master's degree programs delivered entirely in English with international accreditation.

highlights.title: Generous Post-Study Work

highlights.title: High Quality of Life
highlights.desc: Ranked among the top nations globally for safety, equality, environmental sustainability, and student well-being.

overview: The term **MBS (Master's in Business Studies)** may be used informally to describe postgraduate business studies. However, Swedish universities may use official degree titles such as MSc in Business Studies, Business and Management, or Business Administration.
It is also important to distinguish an academic master's degree from an MBA. An MBA is a professional postgraduate qualification generally designed for graduates with relevant work experience.

Tuition fees for international students, including Indian applicants, vary by university and programme. Therefore, students should compare the total cost in Swedish kronor (SEK) and Indian rupees (INR) before applying.
Through **Edu Hawk worldwide study abroad guidance**, students can explore suitable business programmes and understand the admission requirements involved in pursuing higher education in Sweden.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for MBS in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, Indian students with qualifying credentials meeting English language proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) and academic prerequisites can apply to recognized universities in Sweden.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for MBS in Sweden?
items.a: Most master's and international bachelor's degree programmes are taught entirely in English for international students across Swedish universities.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for MBS in Sweden?
items.a: Tuition fees for international students generally range between SEK 80,000 and SEK 150,000 per year, depending on the institution and level of study.

items.q: Can international students work while studying in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, non-EU international students holding a valid Swedish residence permit for higher education are permitted to work alongside their studies without a fixed hours limitation during term time.
